items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: They had a little fella called Leon Monfitt. Monfitt used to play piano... But I played tenor banjo... Well, that's about all they used there in that place there.

ctx.x: Bear Farmer. Bear Farmer. Well, yes. They had a little fella called Leon Monfitt. Monfitt used to play piano, you see. And they had, uh, uh, this, uh, Gabriel, Manuel Gabriel. Manny Gabriel was playing saxophone. But I played tenor banjo, you see. And they had Tommy, uh, Sammy Penn on the drum. Well, that's about all they used there in that place there. They used there, they played there some of the nights a week, you see. Like a Wednesday night and a Saturday night, something like that.
I remember that place during the war. Was that Sammy Penn that plays drums with Thomas' band? Yeah, yeah. That's him.
